title.zh: California's Newsom signs memecoin ban and calls it 'The Opposite of Trump'
title.en: California's Newsom signs memecoin ban and calls it 'The Opposite of Trump'

current_state.zh: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed AB 2409, a memecoin ban included in an anti-corruption package, presenting it as a direct response to President Trump's $TRUMP token episode.
current_state.en: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed AB 2409, a memecoin ban included in an anti-corruption package, presenting it as a direct response to President Trump's $TRUMP token episode.
